recipes.name: Raising Cane’s Cane's Sauce
ingredients: ½ tsp (1g) freshly cracked black pepper
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise, ketchup, Worcestershire, shirodashi, black pepper, salt to taste, and garlic until evenly combined. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, or preferably overnight, to allow the flavors to develop. Stir well before serving.
